data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 中風是以突然昏仆、不省人事，伴口眼喎斜、半身不遂、言語謇澀，或不經昏仆僅見半身不遂等為主要表現的病證，起病急驟，變化迅速，與自然界善行數變之風邪特性相似，故名中風。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 中風，古稱「猝然中風邪」之證，相當於西醫之腦血管意外（CVA），因腦部動脈阻塞或破裂，導致猝然昏仆、半身不遂（偏癱）等症的病證。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Zhong Feng (Wind-Stroke Disease) is characterized by sudden collapse with loss of consciousness, deviation of the eyes and mouth, hemiplegia, and slurred speech — or hemiplegia without collapse. Onset is abrupt and the course changes rapidly, resembling the mobile, changeable nature of Wind, hence the name.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Wind Stroke (Zhong Feng), a TCM term meaning "catching wind", corresponds to Cerebrovascular Accident (CVA), in which the arteries in the brain become blocked or rupture, resulting in hemiplegia.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因平素肝腎陰虛、氣血衰少，加以憂思惱怒、飲食不節、勞逸失度或氣候驟變誘發，以致氣血逆亂，直沖犯腦。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 一為肝陽亢盛、腎陰虧虛；二為痰濕內蘊；三為勞倦過度與情志緊張；四為生活方式失宜。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Usually arises in those with an underlying Liver-Kidney Yin deficiency and Qi-Blood decline, precipitated by worry, anger, dietary irregularity, over-exertion or excessive rest, or sudden weather change, causing Qi and Blood to rebel chaotically upward and rush directly into the brain.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Its TCM etiology comprises: (1) liver yang excess with kidney yin deficiency; (2) phlegm and dampness accumulation; (3) overstrain and stress; (4) lifestyle factors.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 肝腎陰虛則肝陽偏亢,陽亢化風,風火相煽,夾痰夾瘀,上蒙清竅、竄擾經絡,發為中風;病位深淺分中經絡（無神志改變）與中臟腑（神昏），中臟腑又分閉證、脫證。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 病機關鍵有五：風、火、痰、瘀、虛（虛包括血虛、陰虛、津液虧虛）。病位深淺分中經絡與中臟腑：中經絡者病輕，見風邪入中、肝腎陰虛化風、痰熱風痰上擾三種情形；中臟腑者病重，分閉證（實，陽閉、陰閉）與脫證（虛，陽脫、陰脫）；後遺恢復期則見肝腎陰虛、痰濕內蘊、氣血兩虛等傳變。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Liver-Kidney Yin deficiency allows Liver Yang to become hyperactive; hyperactive Yang transforms into Wind, Wind and Fire fan each other, and combined with Phlegm and stasis they cloud the clear orifices above and disrupt the channels — producing stroke. By depth, this is classified as channel-network involvement (no altered consciousness) versus organ involvement (coma), the latter further divided into closed (excess, blockage) and desertion (collapse, deficiency) patterns.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Five key pathogenic factors operate: wind, fire, phlegm, stasis, and deficiency (of blood, yin, and body fluid). By depth, stroke refers to two types: meridian stroke (milder, with three conditions — wind invasion obstruction; liver and kidney yin deficiency stirring up wind; phlegm-heat with wind-phlegm disturbing upward) and zang-fu stroke (severe, divided into the excess/close type — yang bi and yin bi conditions — and the deficiency/open type — yang tuo and yin tuo conditions); in the convalescence stage it evolves into liver-kidney yin deficiency, damp-phlegm accumulation, or qi and blood deficiency.

key_manifestations_zh: 突然半身不遂
口眼喎斜
言語謇澀或不能言
神志不清（重症）
偏身麻木或感覺異常
key_manifestations_en: Sudden hemiplegia (weakness on one side)
Deviation of the eyes and mouth
Slurred speech or inability to speak
Altered consciousness (severe cases)
Numbness or abnormal sensation on one side of the body

key_manifestations_zh: 半身不遂（偏癱）
面部感覺減退
言語異常（謇澀或錯亂）
神志喪失（昏仆）
頭痛
嘔吐

Decreased sensation of the face
Abnormal speech

課件另載證型(詞彙表無 id,未強配): 風邪入中經絡、陽閉、陰閉、陽脫、陰脫、氣虛血瘀。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 面癱是以突然口眼歪斜、患側額紋消失、眼瞼閉合不全為主症的病證，多因正氣不足，脈絡空虛，風邪乘虛入中面部經絡所致。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 面癱（口僻，口眼喎斜）係外感風寒或風熱之邪侵襲面部經絡、絡脈及經筋所致，以口眼喎斜為主要表現的病證，相當於西醫之貝爾氏麻痺。任何年齡、任何時節皆可發病，以二十至四十歲多見，好發於春秋二季，女性較多。西醫對其病因尚不明確。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Facial Paralysis (面癱) is characterized by sudden deviation of the mouth and eyes, loss of forehead wrinkles, and incomplete eyelid closure on the affected side, most often arising when Wind exploits a deficiency of Righteous Qi and an empty channel network to invade the facial channels.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Mian tan (deviation of eye and mouth, known in Chinese as kou yan wai xie) is derived from invasion of the meridians, collaterals and tendon-muscle meridians of the facial region by exogenous pathogenic wind-cold or wind-heat, manifesting as deviation of the eye and mouth; Bell's palsy is similar to this disorder. It can occur at any age and any time, but mostly at 20-40 years old, in spring and fall, and more frequently in females. In Western medicine the cause remains unknown.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 素體正氣不足，脈絡空虛，起居不慎，風寒或風熱之邪乘虛侵襲面部陽明、少陽經絡；或情志不遂、勞倦內傷，氣血運行不暢，筋脈失養。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 面部經絡空虛於先，風寒或風熱之邪乘虛侵襲面部經絡經筋。西醫推測貝爾氏麻痺係免疫或病毒性疾病致面神經腫脹，面神經於顳骨內狹窄之骨管中受壓、缺血所致。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Underlying deficiency of Righteous Qi leaves the channel network empty; careless exposure allows Wind-Cold or Wind-Heat to invade the Yangming and Shaoyang channels of the face while defenses are weak. Emotional strain or overwork may also impair the flow of Qi and Blood, depriving the sinews of nourishment.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Deficiency or vacancy of the facial meridians, plus invasion of pathogenic wind-cold or wind-heat. Western medicine presumably thinks that Bell's palsy involves swelling of the nerve due to immune or viral disease, with ischemia and compression of the facial nerve in the narrow confines of its course through the temporal bone.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 風邪夾寒或夾熱侵襲頭面經絡，經氣阻滯，氣血痹阻，筋肉失於濡養，縱緩不收，發為口眼歪斜；病程日久，氣虛血瘀，脈絡瘀阻，則恢復遲緩或留有後遺症。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 面部經絡空虛，風寒風熱之邪入中，氣血阻滯，陽明、少陽經筋失於濡養，功能失司，面部肌肉筋脈癱緩不收，遂成口眼喎斜。病久遷延者，患側面肌攣縮，口角反牽向患側，是為「倒錯」。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Wind, combined with Cold or Heat, invades the channels of the head and face, obstructing channel Qi and impeding the flow of Qi and Blood; the sinews and muscles lose their nourishment, become slack, and fail to contract, producing the deviated mouth and eyes. In protracted cases, Qi deficiency and Blood stasis obstruct the channels further, slowing recovery or leaving sequelae.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Facial meridian deficiency plus invasion of wind-cold or wind-heat leads to qi and blood stagnation, then malnutrition of the yangming and shaoyang tendon-muscle meridians, failure of their function, and paralysis of the facial muscles and sinews, producing deviation of eye and mouth. If the condition is prolonged, muscle contractures of the affected-side facial muscles may pull the mouth toward the affected side, which is called the 'inverted image'.

key_manifestations_zh: 突然一側口眼歪斜
患側額紋消失、不能皺眉
患側眼瞼閉合不全，露睛流淚
患側鼻唇溝變淺，鼓腮漏氣
部分患者初起耳後或面部輕微疼痛
key_manifestations_en: Sudden deviation of the mouth and eye on one side
Loss of forehead wrinkles and inability to raise the eyebrow on the affected side
Incomplete eyelid closure with exposed sclera and tearing
Flattened nasolabial fold and air leakage when puffing out the cheek
Mild pain behind the ear or on the face at onset in some patients

key_manifestations_zh: 起病突然，多於睡醒後發現，或先有耳後疼痛，癱瘓於數小時內進展，甚可完全
患側眼瞼閉合不全（瞼裂增寬）、口角下垂、鼻唇溝變淺、流涎
不能皺眉、抬眉、閉目、鼓腮、示齒或吹哨
口眼喎斜向健側，或舌前三分之二味覺消失，可伴聽覺過敏、乳突部疼痛或頭痛
患側面部平坦無表情，自覺僵硬、沉重、麻木、弛緩，但無可查之感覺缺失
key_manifestations_en: Sudden onset, often right after waking up, possibly preceded by pain behind the ear; weakness develops within hours, sometimes to complete paralysis
Incomplete closure of the eye on the affected side (widened palpebral fissure), drooping of the angle of the mouth, flattened nasolabial sulcus, salivation
Inability to frown, raise the eyebrow, close the eye, blow out the cheek, show the teeth or whistle
Deviation of eye and mouth to the healthy side; possible disappearance of taste in the front two-thirds of the tongue, with hyperacusis, mastoid-region pain or headache
Affected side flat and expressionless, feeling stiff, heavy, numb and flaccid, but no demonstrable sensory loss

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 心悸是患者自覺心中悸動不安、驚惕不寧，甚則不能自主的病證，可呈陣發性或持續性。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 心悸是指患者自覺心中悸動不安、心跳異常的病證，可表現為心跳過速、心跳漏跳感或心中怦怦跳動，程度輕者常不自覺，重者則明顯可感；發作可見於活動或安靜之時，持續時間自數秒至數小時不等。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Xin Ji (Palpitations) is a disease in which the patient subjectively feels the heart pounding, racing, or fluttering in an unsettled way, sometimes to the point of being unable to control it. It may be paroxysmal or continuous.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Palpitation is a condition in which the patient subjectively perceives an abnormality in the normal beating of the heart, ranging from often unnoticed skipped beats or an accelerated heart rate to very noticeable changes; it can occur whether the patient is active or at rest, and episodes may last from a few seconds to several hours.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因體虛久病（心之氣血陰陽不足）、驚恐惱怒、飲食勞倦，或痰飲、瘀血內阻心脈所致。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 實證多因情志失調（精神因素）、痰濕內停、外邪乘心，或久病所致；虛證多因勞倦過度與久病耗傷而成。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by chronic illness or constitutional weakness (deficiency of Heart Qi, Blood, Yin, or Yang), fright or anger, dietary and physical overexertion, or internal Phlegm-fluids or Blood stasis obstructing the Heart vessels.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Excess-type palpitation arises from emotional/mental disorder, accumulation of phlegm-damp, pathogenic factors invading the heart, or chronic disease; deficiency-type palpitation arises from overstrain and chronic disease.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 心主血脈、藏神；心之氣血陰陽虧虛則心失所養,或痰飲、瘀血阻遏心脈、擾動心神,皆令心動失常而悸。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 本病分虛實兩端：實者瘀血阻絡（心血瘀阻）、痰火擾心，或水飲上凌於心，心神被擾而悸動；虛者心之氣、血、陰、陽虧虛，心失所養，神不守舍而作悸。（講義未另立病機專節，此為其虛實分類與各證型內容之歸納。）

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: The Heart governs the blood vessels and houses the Shen. Deficiency of Heart Qi, Blood, Yin, or Yang leaves the Heart unnourished; alternatively, Phlegm-fluids or Blood stasis obstructing the Heart vessels disturbs the Heart Shen — either mechanism disrupts the normal heartbeat and produces palpitations.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: The disease divides into excess and deficiency: in excess patterns, blood stasis obstructing the heart vessels, phlegm-fire harassing the heart, or pathogenic water attacking the heart disturbs the heart spirit and causes palpitation; in deficiency patterns, deficiency of heart qi, blood, yin, or yang leaves the heart undernourished and the spirit unsettled. (The handout has no separate pathomechanism section; this summarizes its excess/deficiency classification and pattern content.)

key_manifestations_zh: 自覺心跳異常（快、慢或不規則）
心慌不安、驚惕
可伴胸悶、氣短
勞累、情緒激動時誘發或加重
重者伴頭暈、乏力
key_manifestations_en: Subjective awareness of an abnormal heartbeat (fast, slow, or irregular)
A fluttering, unsettled sensation with fright
May accompany chest oppression or shortness of breath
Triggered or worsened by exertion or emotional excitement
Severe cases accompanied by dizziness or weakness

key_manifestations_zh: 心跳過速
心跳漏跳感
心中怦怦悸動
胸部滿悶
暈厥
key_manifestations_en: Rapid heartbeats
Sensation of skipped heartbeats
Pounding feeling in the chest
Chest fullness
Syncope

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 鬱證是因情志不遂、氣機鬱滯所致，以心情抑鬱、情緒不寧、胸脅脹滿疼痛，或易怒善哭、咽中如有異物梗塞等為主要表現的病證。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 鬱證乃情志失調所致之病證，以持續之悲傷、失落、憤怒、煩躁等情緒障礙為主要表現，妨礙日常生活達數週以上；相當於西醫之抑鬱障礙（憂鬱症），不僅見於成人，兒童與青少年亦可罹患，且常與經前綜合徵並見。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Yu Zheng (Depression Pattern Disease) arises from emotional frustration and Qi stagnation, presenting mainly with depressed mood, emotional unease, chest and rib-side distension and pain, or irritability with a tendency to cry, or a sensation of something obstructing the throat.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Yu zheng (depressive disorder) is a mood disorder in which feelings of sadness, loss, anger, or frustration interfere with daily life for weeks or longer; it occurs not only in adults but also in children and teens, and often occurs with PMS.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因情志所傷（憂思、惱怒、悲哀）、素體肝旺或稟賦不足，日久氣鬱化火、化痰，或耗傷心脾氣血、肝腎之陰所致。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 中醫病因為：一、肝氣鬱結；二、心陰虧虛；三、痰濕內擾。西醫確切病因不明，一般認為與腦內化學物質改變有關，可因遺傳因素或應激事件誘發，或兩者兼有；可能之誘因尚包括遺傳、酗酒、藥物濫用、睡眠障礙、精神壓力、某些藥物及某些內科疾病。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by emotional injury (worry, anger, grief), a constitutionally hyperactive Liver, or constitutional weakness. Over time, Qi stagnation may transform into Fire or generate Phlegm, or may exhaust Heart-Spleen Qi-Blood or Liver-Kidney Yin.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: TCM etiology: (1) liver qi stagnation; (2) heart yin deficiency; (3) damp-phlegm disturbances. In Western medicine the exact cause is unknown; it is believed to involve chemical changes in the brain, due to a problem with the genes or triggered by stressful events, or both — possible causes include heredity, alcohol, drug abuse, sleeping disorder, stress, certain medications and certain medical conditions.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 肝主疏泄；情志不遂則肝氣鬱結,氣機失於條達;鬱久化火則見急躁易怒,鬱結成痰則見咽中梗塞（梅核氣）,病久耗傷心脾則心神失養,累及肝腎則陰虛火旺。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 本病病機以實證與虛證分列。實者肝氣鬱結，氣機不暢，胸脅脹悶疼痛；氣滯日久則血行瘀阻而成血瘀；鬱久化火則肝火上炎，兼犯胃腑；氣鬱津凝，聚而成痰，痰氣互結則咽中如有物梗；氣鬱擾心則心神不寧。虛者病久耗傷，心脾兩虛、心陰虧虛、肝陰不足，甚則脾腎陽虛，神失所養而抑鬱纏綿。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: The Liver governs the free flow of Qi. Emotional frustration causes Liver Qi to bind and stagnate, so Qi fails to move smoothly. Prolonged stagnation transforming into Fire produces irritability and a short temper; stagnation congealing into Phlegm produces a throat-obstruction sensation (Plum-Pit Qi); prolonged illness exhausting the Heart and Spleen leaves the Shen unnourished; and involvement of the Liver and Kidney produces Yin deficiency with Fire flaring.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: The handout organizes the pathomechanism into excess and deficiency conditions. In excess, liver qi stagnation obstructs the qi dynamic with distention, stuffiness and pain of the chest and hypochondria; prolonged qi stagnation leads to blood stasis; stagnation transforming into fire gives liver fire uprising that also disturbs stomach function; qi stagnation with phlegm accumulation produces the sensation of an object in the throat that can be neither expectorated nor swallowed; disturbance of the heart shen causes emotional instability. In deficiency, prolonged illness leads to heart and spleen deficiency, heart yin deficiency, liver yin deficiency, and ultimately spleen and kidney yang deficiency, leaving the shen malnourished.

key_manifestations_zh: 情緒抑鬱、悶悶不樂
胸脅脹滿或走竄疼痛
善太息（喜歎氣）
咽中如有異物梗塞（梅核氣）
急躁易怒或易哭善悲
失眠、健忘
key_manifestations_en: Depressed mood, feeling low-spirited
Chest and rib-side distension or migrating pain
Frequent sighing
Sensation of something obstructing the throat (Plum-Pit Qi)
Irritability with a short temper, or a tendency toward sadness and crying
Insomnia, poor memory

key_manifestations_zh: 凡事消極負面，情緒抑鬱，時時嘆息
煩躁不安，易於激動發怒
自覺孤立無援，絕望、無助、無價值感，自責自罪
對既往喜好之活動喪失興趣或樂趣
疲乏，睡眠差，注意力不集中，性慾減退
食慾驟變、體重改變，甚則自傷或有自殺意念
key_manifestations_en: Sees everything in a negative way, depressed mood, often sighing
Agitation, restlessness, irritability and anger
Feeling isolated, hopeless, helpless, worthless, guilty and self-hating
Loss of interest or pleasure in activities that were once enjoyed
Fatigue, poor sleeping, poor concentration, poor sexual drive
Sudden change in appetite, weight changes, and in severe cases hurting themselves or thoughts of suicide

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 虛勞是以臟腑虧損、氣血陰陽不足為主要病機，以長期虛弱證候為主要表現的多種慢性衰弱性病證的總稱，涉及多個臟腑，病程較長。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 虛勞（慢性疲勞綜合徵）指以嚴重而持續之疲倦為特徵的一組症候，其疲倦休息不能緩解，非其他疾病直接引起，病程持續六個月以上。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Xu Lao (Consumptive Deficiency) is a general term for a group of chronic debilitating diseases whose core pathomechanism is organ depletion and Qi-Blood-Yin-Yang insufficiency, presenting as long-standing weakness; it involves multiple organs and follows a prolonged course.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Xu lao (chronic fatigue syndrome) refers to a group of symptoms characterized by severe continued tiredness that is not relieved by rest, is not directly caused by other medical conditions, and lasts more than six months.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 先天稟賦不足；後天飲食失調、勞欲過度；大病久病失於調理；情志內傷，日久耗傷氣血陰陽。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 西醫對本病之機理尚未明瞭，一般認為與EB病毒或人類疱疹病毒六型（HHV-6）感染，以及免疫應答失常所致之神經系統炎症有關。中醫則責之餘邪未淨（外感之後餘邪留戀），以及臟腑氣血陰陽虧虛。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Congenital constitutional insufficiency; acquired dietary imbalance and overexertion (including excessive sexual activity); major or chronic illness without proper convalescent care; or internal emotional damage gradually depleting Qi, Blood, Yin, and Yang.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: In Western medicine this syndrome is not clearly understood; it is believed to be due to Epstein-Barr virus or human herpes virus-6 (HHV-6), and inflammation in the nervous system because of a faulty immune system response. In Chinese medicine it is attributed to residual pathogenic factors after an external invasion (residual EPI) and to deficiency of the zang-fu organs' qi, blood, yin and yang.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 五臟虛損，氣血陰陽不足，互相影響，久則由一臟及多臟，由氣及血、及陰陽，形成氣虛、血虛、陰虛、陽虛及其相兼為病的複雜病機，病程遷延難癒。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 外感之後餘邪未淨：邪留少陽而成少陽證；邪入陽明化熱，上焦則為心熱、肺熱，中焦則發熱心煩，下焦則熱灼傷陰。脾為濕熱所困而脾氣虛；肺之水液下歸於脾而肺氣虛；肝氣橫逆乘脾，肝鬱而脾氣益虛。病久則諸臟虛損：肝血虛、肺陰虛、胃陰虛、腎陰虛、腎陽虛、心血虛、心陰虛，虛勞遂成。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Depletion of the five Zang organs and insufficiency of Qi, Blood, Yin, and Yang mutually interact; over time deficiency spreads from one organ to several, and from Qi to Blood to Yin-Yang, forming complex combined patterns of Qi, Blood, Yin, and Yang deficiency with a protracted, difficult-to-resolve course.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: After an external invasion the residual pathogen lingers: retained in shaoyang it forms a shaoyang pattern; entering yangming it transforms into heat — heat in the upper jiao as heart heat and lung heat, heat in the middle jiao with fever and irritability, and heat in the lower jiao that hurts yin. Spleen damp-heat encumbers the spleen causing spleen qi deficiency; lung fluid falls back to the spleen with lung qi deficiency; liver qi overacts on the spleen, giving liver qi stagnation with spleen qi deficiency. With prolonged illness the organs become depleted: liver blood, lung yin, stomach yin, kidney yin, kidney yang, heart blood and heart yin deficiency.

key_manifestations_zh: 神疲乏力，少氣懶言
形體消瘦或虛浮
面色無華
自汗或盜汗
心悸失眠、腰膝痠軟等因證而異的多臟腑虛損表現
key_manifestations_en: Fatigue, shortness of breath, reluctance to speak
Emaciation or puffy weakness
Lusterless complexion
Spontaneous or night sweating
Palpitations, insomnia, sore weak lower back and knees, and other multi-organ deficiency signs that vary by pattern

肌肉痠痛無力，關節疼痛而無紅腫
失眠，健忘，注意力不集中，神識昏蒙

key_manifestations_en: Persistent fatigue that bed rest does not relieve
Muscle aches and weak muscles; joint pain but no swelling or redness
Insomnia, forgetfulness, poor concentration, confusion
Sore throat, enlargement of lymph nodes, low-grade fever, weak immunity
Headache that differs from the past, tight and painful shoulder muscles, chest pain or congestion
IBS, diarrhea

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 淋證是以小便頻數、淋漓澀痛、小腹拘急引痛為主症的病證，依主症兼夾不同分為熱淋、石淋、氣淋、血淋、膏淋、勞淋六類。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 淋證係以小便頻數急迫、短少澀滯、淋瀝刺痛、排尿困難為主症的病證，多伴小腹拘急或痛引腰腹。約當西醫之尿路感染、膀胱炎、泌尿系結石、前列腺炎、腎小球腎炎、乳糜尿、尿瀦留及膀胱腫瘤等疾患。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Lin Zheng (Strangury) is a disease characterized by frequent, dribbling, painful urination with lower abdominal tension and referred pain. It is classically divided into six types by predominant feature: Heat Lin, Stone Lin, Qi Lin, Blood Lin, Cloudy (Chyluria) Lin, and Fatigue Lin.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Lin syndrome is a disorder characterized by discomfort during urination, with urgency, increased frequency, oliguria, and painful, difficult urination, often with lower abdominal cramping or pain radiating to the lower back. It roughly corresponds to Western conditions such as urinary tract infection, cystitis, urinary calculi, prostatitis, glomerulonephritis, milky urine, urinary retention, and neoplasms of the bladder or prostate.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因濕熱下注膀胱，或情志失調氣滯膀胱，或砂石內結，或久病脾腎兩虛、膀胱氣化無力所致。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 飲食不節，脾生濕濁，釀成內生濕熱；外感濕熱之邪侵犯膀胱；熱邪或濕熱傷及血分；濕熱擾亂膀胱氣化；年老或久病致腎氣虛；脾腎兩虛；情志不遂，肝氣鬱結。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by Damp-Heat pouring down into the Bladder, emotional disturbance causing Qi stagnation in the Bladder, internal formation of stone/gravel, or chronic illness with Spleen-Kidney dual deficiency weakening Bladder Qi transformation.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Improper diet generating internal damp-heat from spleen dampness; exogenous damp-heat invading the urinary bladder; heat or damp-heat injuring the blood; damp-heat disturbing the bladder's function of qi transformation; old age or chronic illness causing kidney qi deficiency; deficiency of spleen and kidney; emotional stress stagnating liver qi.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 膀胱主藏津液、司氣化；濕熱蘊結膀胱則氣化失司、水道不利而為熱淋；砂石內結、氣滯血瘀者亦阻遏水道；久病脾腎兩虛則膀胱氣化無力、淋證遇勞即發，稱勞淋。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 病位主在膀胱與腎，並涉及脾、肝。基本病機為濕熱、濕寒等病邪阻滯水道，膀胱、腎之氣化失司；或兼氣虛、陰虛不能司膀胱開闔。濕熱蘊結下焦煎熬成石則為石淋；肝氣鬱滯、氣機不利則為氣淋；熱傷血絡則為血淋；濕濁不化則為膏淋；久病耗傷氣血陰精，脾腎虛憊，病情纏綿反覆，則轉為勞淋。實證多急，虛證多慢性反覆。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: The Bladder stores fluids and governs Qi transformation. Damp-Heat accumulating in the Bladder impairs Qi transformation and obstructs the waterways, producing Heat Lin. Internal stone formation or Qi stagnation with Blood stasis likewise obstructs the waterways. Chronic Spleen-Kidney dual deficiency weakens Bladder Qi transformation so the condition flares with exertion — termed Fatigue Lin.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: The disease is located mainly in the bladder and kidney, involving the spleen and liver. The key pathology is obstruction of the water passages by pathogenic factors, most often damp-heat or damp-cold, impairing bladder and kidney qi transformation, with possible underlying deficiency of qi or yin that fails to regulate urination. Damp-heat condensing in the lower burner produces stones (stone lin); liver qi stagnation obstructing the water passages produces qi lin; heat injuring the collaterals produces blood lin; unresolved damp turbidity produces cloudy lin; chronic depletion of qi, blood, or yin with spleen-kidney deficiency produces recurrent, lingering fatigue lin. Excess patterns are acute; deficiency patterns are chronic and recurrent.

key_manifestations_zh: 小便頻數、短澀
排尿灼熱刺痛
小腹拘急疼痛，或引腰腹
尿中夾砂石（石淋）或血（血淋）或混濁如膏（膏淋）
遇勞即發或加重（勞淋）
key_manifestations_en: Frequent, scant, hesitant urination
Burning, stabbing pain on urination
Lower abdominal tension and pain, sometimes radiating to the back
Gravel in the urine (Stone Lin), blood (Blood Lin), or cloudy discharge (Cloudy/Chyluria Lin)
Triggered or worsened by exertion (Fatigue Lin)

key_manifestations_zh: 小便頻數急迫
排尿澀痛困難，尿道灼熱刺痛
小便短少色深
小腹拘急脹痛，排尿時可痛引腰部
隨證型不同可兼見尿中砂石、血尿或小便渾濁如膏
key_manifestations_en: Frequent, urgent urination
Painful, difficult urination with burning sensation and sharp pain in the urethra
Dark, scanty urine
Lower abdominal cramping and pain that may radiate to the lower back during urination
Depending on the type, sand or stones in the urine, hematuria, or cloudy, milky urine

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 遺尿是指三歲以上小兒或成人於睡眠中不自覺地排尿，醒後方覺的病證，亦稱「尿床」。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 遺尿（尿床）指三歲以上小兒於睡眠中不自主排尿的病證，即在無意識之睡眠狀態下尿液不自主漏出，多見於幼童。中醫認為本病與肺、脾、腎及膀胱相關。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Enuresis (遺尿) refers to involuntary urination during sleep in children over three years of age or in adults, with the person only becoming aware after waking; also known as "bedwetting."
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Yi niao (nocturnal enuresis, bedwetting) refers to urination during sleep in children over three years old — accidental urine leakage while in an unconscious condition during sleeping, usually related to young children. In TCM, enuresis is associated with the lung, spleen, kidney and urinary bladder.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因先天稟賦不足、腎氣未充或腎氣虛衰，膀胱失於約束；或肺脾氣虛，水道通調失職；或肝經濕熱下注，擾動膀胱氣化。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 素體虛弱，腎氣不足，肺脾氣虛。此外尚有久病體衰、胎兒或小兒發育期間受驚、年老生理機能衰退、房勞過度耗傷腎精、產育耗損精氣、久咳不已等因素。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly due to congenital insufficiency with the Kidney Qi not yet full (in children) or Kidney Qi decline (in adults), leaving the Bladder without restraint; or Lung-Spleen Qi deficiency impairing the regulation of water pathways; or Liver-channel Damp-Heat pouring downward and disturbing Bladder Qi transformation.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Weak constitution, kidney qi deficiency, and lung qi and spleen qi deficiency. Additional contributing factors include long-term debilitating disease, shock to the developing child or fetus, physiological change of old age, excessive sexual activity causing kidney essence deficiency, childbirth using up essence, and chronic cough with the repeated act of coughing.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 腎為水臟，主司二便，膀胱與腎相表裡，賴腎氣的溫煦固攝以司開闔；腎氣不足則膀胱失約，睡中遺尿；肺脾氣虛，上虛不能制下，亦致膀胱失約；濕熱下注膀胱，氣化失司，亦可擾動而遺尿。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 虛者為主：腎陽虛衰、下焦虛寒，膀胱失於約束；腎陰虧虛，膀胱失司則尿後餘瀝；脾氣虛而下陷、肺氣虛弱，上虛不能制下，咳嗽噴嚏之際尿液外漏。實者為次：肝火內擾、心火亢盛，擾動心神則夜寐不安而遺尿；濕熱下注膀胱，膀胱失約則遺尿且小便灼熱不利。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: The Kidney is the Water organ governing urination and defecation; the Bladder is exteriorly-interiorly linked with the Kidney and relies on Kidney Qi's warming and consolidating action to control opening and closing. When Kidney Qi is insufficient, the Bladder loses restraint and enuresis occurs during sleep. Lung-Spleen Qi deficiency ("upper deficiency failing to control the lower") likewise causes loss of Bladder restraint; Damp-Heat pouring into the Bladder can also disturb Qi transformation and produce enuresis.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Deficiency types predominate: kidney yang deficiency with lower jiao cold and deficiency leaves the bladder unrestrained; kidney yin deficiency causes dribbling after urination with reduced force; spleen qi deficiency or sinking and lung qi deficiency mean the upper cannot control the lower, with leakage on coughing or sneezing. Excess types: liver fire and heart fire disturb the spirit, causing restless sleep and enuresis; damp-heat pouring down into the urinary bladder deprives it of restraint, with burning, difficult urination.

key_manifestations_zh: 睡眠中不自覺排尿，醒後方知
可一夜一次或多次，甚則每夜遺尿
兼見面色蒼白、肢冷畏寒、腰膝痠軟（腎氣不固者）
兼見神疲乏力、食欲不振、自汗（肺脾氣虛者）
兼見尿黃、尿味臊臭、性情急躁（肝經濕熱者）
key_manifestations_en: Involuntary urination during sleep, noticed only after waking
May occur once or multiple times per night, or nightly in severe cases
Pale complexion, cold limbs, aversion to cold, and lower back/knee soreness (Kidney Qi not firm)
Fatigue, poor appetite, and spontaneous sweating (Lung-Spleen Qi deficiency)
Dark, strong-smelling urine and irritability (Liver-channel Damp-Heat)

key_manifestations_zh: 睡眠中不自主排尿（尿床）
尿頻、夜尿，或尿後餘瀝不盡
兼氣虛者疲乏、納差、便溏、聲低息弱、自汗，咳嗽噴嚏時少量漏尿
兼火擾者夜寐不安、多夢、夜間齘齒或哭鬧
兼濕熱者小便困難、尿時灼熱
key_manifestations_en: Involuntary urination during sleep (bedwetting)
Frequent urination, nocturia, or dribbling after urination
With qi deficiency: fatigue, poor appetite, loose stool, soft weak voice, spontaneous sweat, slight leakage on coughing or sneezing
With fire disturbance: restless sleep, nightmares, teeth grinding or crying at night
With damp-heat: difficult urination, burning urination

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 陽痿係指男子未逾八八天癸之年，陰莖持續痿軟不舉，或舉而不堅，不能完成正常房事的病證，即西醫之勃起功能障礙。中醫又稱陰痿、筋痿。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Impotence (陽痿) refers to a condition in adult men where the penis fails to become erect during intercourse, or the erection is insufficiently firm, or firm but not sustained, preventing completion of normal sexual activity.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Yang wei (impotence) refers to the male sexual dysfunction, occurring in men who have not yet passed the age of eight-times-eight of Tian Gui, characterized by the persistent inability to develop or maintain an erection of the penis satisfactory for sexual performance; it corresponds to erectile dysfunction (ED) in Western medicine. Alternative TCM names include yin wei and jin wei.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因房事不節、手淫過度，命門火衰；或思慮傷脾、憂鬱傷肝，情志不遂；或濕熱下注，宗筋弛縱；或驚恐傷腎，腎氣不固。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 先天稟賦不足；命門火衰；心脾兩虛；情志所傷（肝氣鬱結，或恐懼傷腎）；濕熱下注下焦；陰津虧虛；陰陽兩虛；痰濕阻滯；局部脈絡阻滯；寒滯肝經；氣滯血瘀。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by excessive sexual activity or masturbation depleting Life-Gate Fire; overthinking damaging the Spleen or depression damaging the Liver with unresolved emotion; Damp-Heat pouring downward and slackening the ancestral sinew; or fright damaging the Kidney and unsettling Kidney Qi.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Poor congenital constitution; ming men fire deficiency; heart and spleen deficiency; emotional injury (liver qi stagnation, or fear damaging the kidney); damp-heat invading the lower jiao; yin fluid deficiency; combined yin and yang deficiency; phlegm-damp blockage; local blockage; cold invading the liver meridian; qi stagnation with blood stasis.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 陰莖為宗筋所聚，其勃起有賴腎陽溫煦、肝之疏泄、心神調攝；命門火衰，宗筋失於溫煦，則陽事不舉；肝鬱氣滯，或濕熱下注宗筋，亦可致陽痿；久病及心脾，心脾兩虛，氣血不足，宗筋失養。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 講義未設專門病機論述，據其分型可知：或因先天不足、命門火衰、心脾氣血虧虛、陰津不足，宗筋失於溫煦濡養；或因濕熱、痰濕、寒邪、氣滯血瘀阻滯肝經與局部脈絡，宗筋弛縱不用而痿。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: The penis is where the ancestral sinews converge; erection depends on the warming of Kidney Yang, the free-flow governed by the Liver, and regulation by the Heart-Spirit. When Life-Gate Fire declines, the ancestral sinew loses its warming and fails to rise. Liver Qi stagnation, or Damp-Heat pouring into the ancestral sinew, can likewise cause impotence. With prolonged illness affecting the Heart and Spleen, Heart-Spleen deficiency and Qi-Blood insufficiency leave the ancestral sinew unnourished.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: The handout has no dedicated pathomechanism discussion; from its clinical classification, the disorder arises either from deficiency — poor congenital constitution, ming men fire deficiency, heart-spleen deficiency, or yin fluid deficiency depriving the ancestral sinew of warmth and nourishment — or from excess — damp-heat, phlegm-damp, cold in the liver meridian, or qi stagnation with blood stasis obstructing the channels locally — so that the ancestral sinew becomes slack and fails to rise.

key_manifestations_zh: 陰莖不能勃起，或勃起不堅、不能持久
腰膝痠軟、畏寒肢冷、精神萎靡（命門火衰者）
情緒抑鬱、胸脅脹悶、興趣減退（肝鬱氣滯者）
陰囊潮濕臊臭、小便黃赤（濕熱下注者）
心悸失眠、神疲納差（心脾兩虛者）
key_manifestations_en: Inability to achieve erection, or erection that is insufficiently firm or not sustained
Lower back/knee soreness, cold aversion with cold limbs, and low spirits (Life-Gate Fire decline)
Depressed mood, chest and hypochondriac fullness, and diminished interest (Liver Qi stagnation)
Damp, malodorous scrotum and dark-yellow urine (Damp-Heat pouring downward)
Palpitations, insomnia, fatigue, and poor appetite (Heart-Spleen deficiency)

key_manifestations_zh: 陰莖痿軟不能勃起，或舉而不堅
腰痠膝軟、乏力、畏寒、頭暈耳鳴（命門火衰者）
心悸、氣短、自汗、納差、便溏（心脾兩虛者）
小便灼熱、陰部潮濕瘙癢、口渴（濕熱下注者）
陰部發涼、少腹掣痛、小便清長（寒滯肝經者）
key_manifestations_en: Inability to develop or maintain an erection of the penis
Sore lower back, weak knees, fatigue, aversion to cold, dizziness, and tinnitus (ming men fire deficiency)
Palpitations, shortness of breath, spontaneous sweating, poor appetite, and loose stools (heart-spleen deficiency)
Burning urination, itchy and damp genitals, and thirst (damp-heat invading the lower jiao)
Cold genital area, pulling pain toward the lower abdomen, and profuse urination (cold invading the liver meridian)

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 腰痛是以腰部一側或兩側疼痛為主症的病證，可急性發作亦可反覆遷延，是內科、傷科皆常見的病證。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 腰痛係指腰部一側、兩側或正中疼痛之病證，首載於《黃帝內經·素問》第四十一篇。腰痛可見於腎臟、婦科、脊柱及腰部筋肉等多種疾病；腰為腎之府，故腰痛與腎之關係最為密切。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Yao Tong (Lumbar Pain) is a disease characterized by pain in one or both sides of the lower back. It may present acutely or as a recurrent, chronic complaint, and is common in both internal medicine and orthopedic-traumatology practice.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Lower back pain (yao tong) is first mentioned in the Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic (Huang Di Nei Jing, Su Wen), Chapter 41. It can occur unilaterally, bilaterally, or centrally, and is present in many diseases such as those of the kidneys, gynecology, the spinal column, and the lumbar muscles. TCM holds that the lower back region is the residence of the Kidneys, thus lower back pain has a close relationship with the Kidneys.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因外感風寒濕邪、跌仆閃挫、久坐久立勞損，或年老腎虧所致；腎為腰之府，腎虛為腰痛的重要內因。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 病涉腎、肝與督脈、膀胱經、帶脈。實證：外感寒濕或濕熱之邪，或勞損外傷（扭挫傷），致氣血瘀滯於經絡；虛證：稟賦不足、年老體衰、久病耗損，致精血虧耗、腎精衰減。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by external Wind-Cold-Damp invasion, trauma or a sudden wrenching strain, chronic strain from prolonged sitting or standing, or age-related Kidney depletion. The Kidney "resides" in the lower back, making Kidney vacuity a key internal cause of lumbar pain.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: The Kidneys, Liver, Du vessel, Bladder channel, and Dai vessel are involved. Excess (shi): contraction of external pathogenic influences — invasion of cold-damp or damp-heat — or overexertion and trauma (sprain/contusion), leading to qi and blood stagnation in the meridians and collaterals. Deficiency (xu): constitutional weakness, old age, or chronic illness, leading to exhaustion and weakening of essence and blood and a decline of Kidney essence.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 腎虛則腰府失養、隱隱作痛;寒濕、濕熱之邪痺阻腰部經脈,或跌仆傷絡、瘀血阻滯,皆令腰部氣血不通而痛,不榮則痛與不通則痛可並見。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 實者，寒濕、濕熱之邪客於經絡，或跌仆勞損，氣血瘀滯，經脈不通則痛；虛者，精血虧耗，腎精衰減，經絡失於濡養，不榮則痛。臨證分寒濕、濕熱、瘀血、腎虛四型。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Kidney vacuity leaves the lumbar region unnourished, producing a dull, lingering ache. Cold-Damp or Damp-Heat obstructing the lumbar channels, or trauma injuring the network vessels with Blood stasis, obstruct the local flow of Qi and Blood and cause pain — the two mechanisms of "lack of nourishment" and "lack of free flow" may coexist.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: In excess types, cold-damp or damp-heat lodges in the meridians, or overexertion and trauma cause qi and blood to stagnate, obstructing the channels and producing pain; in deficiency types, essence and blood are exhausted, Kidney essence declines, and the meridians and collaterals are deprived of nourishment, producing pain. Clinically it is differentiated into four types: cold-damp, damp-heat, blood stagnation, and Kidney deficiency.

key_manifestations_zh: 腰部一側或兩側疼痛
痠痛、脹痛、刺痛或冷痛（隨證不同）
勞累後加重、休息可緩解（腎虛型）
陰雨天或受寒加重（寒濕型）
痛處固定、夜間加重（瘀血型）
key_manifestations_en: Pain in one or both sides of the lower back
Aching, distending, stabbing, or cold pain (varies by pattern)
Worsened by exertion, relieved by rest (Kidney-vacuity type)
Worsened by rainy weather or cold exposure (Cold-Damp type)
Fixed location, worse at night (Blood-stasis type)

key_manifestations_zh: 寒濕型：腰部冷痛重著，如有物下墜，晨起下床或陰雨天加重，轉側不利，舌苔白膩，脈沉
濕熱型：腰痛而有熱感，口苦心煩，小便短赤，舌苔黃膩，脈濡數
瘀血型：腰痛日久，痛如錐刺，或有外傷史，痛處固定，拒按，轉側不利，舌紫黯或有瘀點，脈澀
腎虛型：腰痛隱隱，痠軟無力，腿膝乏力，時作時止，勞則加重，兼見頭暈目眩、耳鳴、遺精，舌苔薄，脈沉細，尺部尤甚
key_manifestations_en: Cold-damp: cold lower back pain with a heavy dragging sensation, worse when getting up from bed or on rainy days, difficulty moving the back, white sticky tongue coating, deep pulse
Damp-heat: lower back pain with a sensation of heat, bitter taste in the mouth, restlessness, scanty deep-yellow urine, yellow sticky tongue coating, soft and rapid pulse
Blood stagnation: long-standing sharp pain or a history of trauma, fixed in location, worse on pressure, difficulty moving the back, purplish tongue or purple spots, hesitant pulse

Kidney deficiency: dull pain, sore and weak in nature, weakness of the legs, comes and goes, aggravated on exertion, with dizziness, blurred vision, tinnitus, nocturnal emission, thin tongue coating, thready deep pulse pronounced at the chi positions

key_manifestations_zh: curriculum/conditions/LBP1.md（2026-08-19 課件萃取）
related_patterns: curriculum/conditions/LBP1.md（2026-08-19 課件萃取）
課件另載證型(詞彙表無 id,未強配): 寒濕。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 痺證是因風、寒、濕、熱等外邪侵襲肢體、經絡、關節，導致氣血運行不暢，出現肌肉、筋骨、關節疼痛、麻木、重著、屈伸不利，甚則關節腫大變形的病證。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 痺證於本講義以纖維肌痛症為載體講授：屬全身廣泛性疼痛、僵硬之病證。其痹證型以惡寒、惡陰雨天氣、肢體麻木、自覺手指足趾腫脹為特徵；局部無紅、腫、熱，關節活動度不受限。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Bi Zheng (Bi Syndrome / Painful Obstruction) results from Wind, Cold, Damp, or Heat pathogens invading the limbs, channels, and joints, obstructing the flow of Qi and Blood and producing pain, numbness, heaviness, and restricted movement of muscles, sinews, bones, and joints, with severe cases showing joint swelling and deformity.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Bi syndrome is taught in this handout through fibromyalgia: a condition of widespread body pain and stiffness. Its Bi-syndrome type is characterized by aversion to cold and rainy weather, numbness of the limbs, and a frequent complaint of swollen fingers and toes; there is no local redness, swelling or heat, and no limitation of range of motion.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 外邪侵襲肢體經絡,阻遏氣血運行,不通則痛;風邪偏盛則痛處遊走（行痺）,寒邪偏盛則痛劇而定處（痛痺）,濕邪偏盛則重著腫脹（著痺）,熱邪偏盛則紅腫灼痛（熱痺）;病久邪留關節,痰瘀互結,可致關節腫大變形。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 講義未直接論述中醫病機；由其治療原則（促進局部血液循環、消散水濕、去除阻滯、補益氣血、止痛）可見其機轉為局部氣血阻滯、水濕停聚，部分患者兼有氣血不足。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: External pathogens invading the limb channels obstruct the flow of Qi and Blood — "no free flow, hence pain." A predominance of Wind produces migratory pain (Wandering Bi); a predominance of Cold produces severe fixed pain (Painful Bi); a predominance of Dampness produces heaviness and swelling (Fixed Bi); a predominance of Heat produces redness, swelling, and burning pain (Heat Bi). Chronic retention of the pathogen in the joints, with Phlegm and stasis intertwining, can lead to joint swelling and deformity.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: The handout does not state the TCM pathomechanism directly; from its stated treatment principles (promote local blood circulation, disperse fluids, remove blockage, tonify qi and blood, stop pain), the mechanism is local obstruction of qi and blood with retained fluids, with concurrent qi and blood deficiency in some patients.

key_manifestations_zh: 肢體關節疼痛
關節腫脹或屈伸不利
肌膚麻木、重著感
疼痛遊走不定或固定不移（隨證不同）
遇寒或陰雨天加重（寒濕型）
key_manifestations_en: Limb and joint pain
Joint swelling or restricted flexion/extension
Numbness or a heavy sensation in the skin/muscles
Migratory or fixed pain (varies by pattern)
Worsened by cold or rainy weather (Cold-Damp type)

key_manifestations_zh: 全身廣泛性疼痛與僵硬，特定壓痛點按壓（4公斤力）即劇痛
惡寒、惡陰雨天氣，對寒冷潮濕氣候高度敏感（痹證型）
肢體麻木，常自覺手指、足趾腫脹（痹證型）
局部無紅、腫、熱，關節活動度不受限，X光與檢驗均正常
舌體胖大、苔白膩；脈緊而滑（痹證型舌脈）
key_manifestations_en: Widespread pain and stiffness, with extreme pain on tender points under 4 kg of palpation force
Aversion to cold and rainy weather, with severe sensitivity to cold and damp conditions (Bi-syndrome type)
Numbness of the limbs, with frequent complaints of swollen fingers and toes (Bi-syndrome type)
No local redness, swelling or heat, no limitation of range of motion, and normal X-ray and laboratory findings
Big tongue body with a white, greasy coating; tight and slippery pulse (tongue and pulse of the Bi-syndrome type)

課件另載證型(詞彙表無 id,未強配): 痹證型（講義僅稱 Bi Syndrome，未細分為風寒濕痹或熱痹，故不強行對映）。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 痿證是以肢體筋脈弛緩、軟弱無力，不能隨意運動，甚則肌肉萎縮為主要表現的病證，病位在筋脈肌肉，與五臟關係密切，尤以肺、脾、肝、腎為要。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 痿證為以肢體軟弱無力、甚則癱瘓不用、肌肉萎縮為主要表現的病證，病位與肺、脾、腎、肝相關。西醫之多發性硬化症（Multiple Sclerosis）在中醫屬痿證範疇。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Wei Zheng (Wei Syndrome, Atrophy-Flaccidity) is characterized by flaccid, weak sinews and limbs with loss of voluntary movement, severe cases showing muscle atrophy; the disease location is the sinews and muscles, closely related to all five Zang organs, especially the Lung, Spleen, Liver, and Kidney.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Wei syndrome (atrophy-flaccidity syndrome) is a disorder characterized by limb weakness and flaccidity, in severe cases paralysis and muscular atrophy; it is associated with the lung, spleen, kidney and liver. In Chinese medicine, multiple sclerosis falls into the category of Wei syndrome.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 溫熱邪毒傷肺，肺熱葉焦；濕熱浸淫筋脈；脾胃虛弱，精微不布；肝腎虧損，精血不能濡養筋脈。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 一、外邪侵襲：以濕邪侵襲最為常見；亦可因風熱（伴高熱之強烈風熱型）而發。二、飲食不節：過食生濕之品及發物。三、房勞過度：耗傷腎精。四、驚恐及劇烈情志刺激：以心、脾受損最重。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Warm-Heat toxin injuring the Lung and scorching the Lung lobes; Damp-Heat soaking into the sinews; Spleen-Stomach weakness failing to distribute nutrient essence; or Liver-Kidney depletion with Essence-Blood unable to nourish the sinews.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 1. Invasion of external pathogens: damp invasion is the most common cause; a strong type of wind-heat with high fever may also be responsible. 2. Diet: damp-producing foods and excessive consumption of Fa Wu (stimulating foods). 3. Excessive sexual activity, which depletes the kidney. 4. Shock and severe emotions, with the heart and spleen taking the greatest hit.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 肺主身之皮毛，為水之上源；脾主四肢肌肉；肝主筋，腎主骨生髓；凡邪熱傷肺、濕熱浸淫、脾胃虛弱或肝腎虧損，皆可致精血津液不能濡養筋脈肌肉，「宗筋失養，弛縱不收」而成痿。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 本病與肺、脾、腎、肝有關。其機轉可見：痰熱阻滯經絡（熱後突發肢體無力、麻木或癱瘓）；濕熱浸淫（肢體無力漸起，以下肢為著）；瘀血阻於經絡（肢體無力伴麻木、刺痛或攣痛，肌肉萎縮）；肺脾兩虛（肢體無力緩慢進展，伴肌肉萎縮）；肝腎虧虛（全身癱瘓、消瘦、腰膝痠軟，見陰虛內熱之象）；腎陽衰憊（全身癱瘓、肢冷畏寒、二便失司）。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: The Lung governs the body's skin and hair and is the upper source of water; the Spleen governs the limbs and muscles; the Liver governs the sinews and the Kidney governs bones and generates marrow. Pathogenic Heat injuring the Lung, Damp-Heat soaking in, Spleen-Stomach weakness, or Liver-Kidney depletion can all leave Essence, Blood, and fluids unable to nourish the sinews and muscles — "the governing sinews lose nourishment and become flaccid" — producing Wei syndrome.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: The disease involves the lung, spleen, kidney and liver. Its mechanisms include: obstruction of the meridians by phlegm and heat (sudden limb weakness, numbness or paralysis after fever); damp-heat dissemination (gradual limb weakness, most obvious in the lower limbs); blood stasis accumulated in the meridians (limb weakness with numbness, tingling or contracting pain and muscular atrophy); deficiencies of lung and spleen (slow, progressive limb weakness with atrophy); deficiencies of liver and kidney (general paralysis, weight loss, lumbar and knee soreness with signs of deficiency heat); and depletion of kidney yang (general paralysis with cold limbs, cold intolerance and impaired urination and bowel function).

key_manifestations_zh: 肢體筋脈弛緩，軟弱無力
不能隨意運動，甚則肌肉萎縮
可由下肢開始，漸及上肢
病情進展可見呼吸肌無力
久病可伴肌肉萎縮、皮膚枯槁
key_manifestations_en: Flaccid sinews and limbs, weakness
Loss of voluntary movement, severe cases with muscle atrophy
May begin in the lower limbs and progress to the upper limbs
Progression may involve respiratory muscle weakness
Chronic cases: muscle atrophy and withered skin

key_manifestations_zh: 肢體軟弱無力，甚則癱瘓，以下肢為著
肌肉萎縮
肢體麻木、刺痛或攣痛
步態不穩、震顫、動作笨拙
視物模糊、複視，甚則失明
小便困難或失禁等二便功能障礙
key_manifestations_en: Limb weakness, in severe cases paralysis, most obvious in the lower limbs
Muscular atrophy
Numbness, tingling or contracting pain of the limbs
Unsteady gait, tremor and clumsiness
Blurred vision, double vision, or even blindness
Urinary difficulty or incontinence and other disorders of excretory function

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 落枕是指因睡姿不當或頸部受風寒，晨起後突發頸項強痛、轉側不利的病證，多能自行或經治療於一至二週內緩解。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 落枕指因睡眠姿勢不當，或風寒之邪侵襲頸項，導致所涉經脈局部氣機運行失調而發的急性頸項強痛（斜頸），多見於成年人。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Stiff Neck (落枕) refers to sudden onset of neck pain and stiffness with restricted rotation upon waking, typically caused by an awkward sleeping posture or exposure of the neck to Wind-Cold; it usually resolves spontaneously or with treatment within one to two weeks.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Luo zhen (stiff neck, wryneck / torticollis) refers to acute stiffness and pain of the neck caused by an inappropriate sleeping posture or an attack of wind-cold on the neck and nape, leading to disturbance of the local circulation of qi in the involved meridians; it occurs mostly in adults.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因睡眠姿勢不當，頸部肌肉長時間受牽拉；或夜臥受風寒侵襲頸項經絡，氣血凝滯；素體氣血不足、頸部經筋失養者更易發作。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 睡眠姿勢不當；風寒之邪侵襲頸項。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by an awkward sleeping posture that stretches the neck muscles for a prolonged period, or Wind-Cold invading the neck channels during sleep and causing Qi-Blood to congeal; those with underlying Qi-Blood insufficiency and undernourished neck sinews are more prone to episodes.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Inappropriate sleeping posture; invasion of the neck and nape by wind-cold.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 頸項經筋因姿勢不當或風寒侵襲，局部氣血運行受阻，經脈拘急，不通則痛，發為頸項強痛、活動受限。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 睡姿不當或風寒外襲，擾亂頸項部所涉經脈之局部氣機，氣血運行阻滯，筋脈拘急而見強直疼痛；故治以祛風散寒、舒筋活血、溫通經脈、去除阻滯。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: The sinew channels of the neck become locally obstructed in Qi-Blood flow due to an awkward posture or Wind-Cold invasion; the channels become tense and contracted, producing pain from lack of free flow, presenting as neck stiffness, pain, and restricted movement.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Poor sleeping posture or external wind-cold disturbs the local circulation of qi in the meridians traversing the neck; qi and blood become obstructed and the sinews cramp, producing stiffness and pain — hence the treatment principle of expelling wind and dispersing cold, relaxing the sinews, activating blood and qi circulation, warming the meridians and removing stagnation.

key_manifestations_zh: 晨起突發頸項強痛，多為一側
頭項轉側活動受限，動則痛甚
可觸及局部肌肉緊張、壓痛
疼痛可牽及肩背
一般無發熱、上肢放射麻木等全身或神經症狀
key_manifestations_en: Sudden onset of one-sided neck pain and stiffness upon waking
Restricted turning of the head and neck, with pain worsened by movement
Palpable local muscle tension and tenderness
Pain may radiate to the shoulder and upper back
Generally no fever or radiating arm numbness/systemic or neurologic symptoms

key_manifestations_zh: 一側頸項強直疼痛，頭歪向一側、活動受限；患者常保持頭偏向患側以減輕疼痛與痙攣
強直疼痛可放散至患側肩臂，偶爾頸項與肩部雙側同時受累
觸診頸項部有壓痛與肌肉痙攣，但無紅、熱、腫
或兼見風寒表證
若經治療疼痛強直仍逾一週不解，應轉介西醫評估頸椎疾患
key_manifestations_en: Stiffness and pain of the neck and nape on one side, with the head wried toward one side and motor impairment; most patients keep the head toward the affected side to reduce pain and spasm
Stiffness and pain may spread to the shoulder and arm on the affected side; occasionally both sides of the nape and shoulder are involved
Palpation shows tenderness and muscular spasm in the neck and nape area, but no redness, heat or swelling
Wind-cold symptoms may accompany the neck stiffness and pain
If pain and stiffness persist beyond a week despite treatment, refer to a physician to evaluate for cervical vertebrae disorders

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 肩凝症又稱漏肩風、五十肩，是以肩部疼痛、活動受限，日久肩部肌肉萎縮、狀如凝結為主症的病證，好發於50歲左右。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 肩凝症（漏肩風），即凍結肩；因多發於五十歲左右之人，中醫又稱「五十肩」。相當於西醫之肩關節周圍炎，以肩部疼痛與各方向活動受限為特徵。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Frozen Shoulder (肩凝症), also called "leaking-shoulder wind" (漏肩風) or "fifty-shoulder" (五十肩), is characterized by shoulder pain and restricted movement, with muscle atrophy developing over time as if the joint had "frozen"; it most often occurs around age 50.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Jian ning (frozen shoulder, also called 'leaking shoulder wind'), known in TCM as the 'fifty-year-old shoulder' because it usually occurs in people around their fifties; in Western medicine it corresponds to periarthritis of the shoulder joint, characterized by shoulder pain and limitation of motion in all directions.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因年老體衰、氣血漸虧，肩部經脈失養；或勞損外傷，筋脈受損；或睡臥露肩，風寒濕邪乘虛侵襲肩部經絡，痹阻氣血。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 腎虛（組織退化）；勞倦耗傷之際感受風寒濕邪，致肩部氣血凝滯；肩關節周圍組織損傷；睡中氣虛受邪；缺乏運動。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by advancing age with declining Qi-Blood leaving the shoulder channels unnourished; or overuse strain and trauma damaging the sinews; or sleeping with the shoulder exposed, allowing Wind-Cold-Damp to invade the shoulder channels while defenses are weak and obstruct Qi-Blood flow.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Kidney deficiency (degeneration); exhaustion with subsequent attack by wind-cold-damp, leading to qi and blood stagnation at the shoulder; injury to the tissues around the shoulder joint; qi deficiency while asleep; lack of exercise.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 肩部經脈氣血本已漸虛，復感風寒濕邪，或勞損傷及筋脈，致使局部氣血凝滯、經脈痹阻，不通則痛；病久氣血虛損，筋脈失於濡養，則肩部活動日漸受限，肌肉萎縮。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 腎虛則筋骨組織退化；勞倦氣虛之時風寒濕邪乘襲肩部，氣血凝滯不通而作痛。其病程具三個特點：初期以疼痛為主；後期因肩周粘連而以活動受限為主；最終因患肩少動、不動而肩臂肌肉萎縮。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: With the shoulder channels' Qi-Blood already gradually deficient, further invasion by Wind-Cold-Damp, or strain damaging the sinews, causes local Qi-Blood to congeal and the channels to become obstructed, producing pain from lack of free flow. With prolonged illness, Qi-Blood deficiency leaves the sinews unnourished, so shoulder movement becomes progressively restricted and the muscles atrophy.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Kidney deficiency underlies tissue degeneration; when the body is exhausted, wind-cold-damp attacks the shoulder and qi and blood stagnate there, producing pain. The course has three characteristics: at the initial stage pain predominates; at the late stage limitation of range of motion predominates due to adhesion around the shoulder; finally the affected shoulder and arm become atrophic from lack of motion.

key_manifestations_zh: 肩部疼痛，夜間或遇冷加重
肩關節活動範圍逐漸縮小，外展、上舉、後伸受限
病程日久可見肩部肌肉萎縮
疼痛可牽及上臂，但一般無手部麻木無力
病情發展多分為疼痛期、僵硬期、緩解期
key_manifestations_en: Shoulder pain, worsened at night or with cold exposure
Progressively decreasing range of shoulder motion — restricted abduction, elevation, and extension behind the back
Muscle atrophy of the shoulder in long-standing cases
Pain may radiate to the upper arm, but generally without hand numbness or weakness
The course typically passes through painful, stiffening, and resolving stages

key_manifestations_zh: 初起患側肩部輕度酸楚或疼痛（常被忽視），活動與勞累後逐漸加重
疼痛漸進加劇並擴散至鄰近組織——上及頸項、下至上臂、後及項背肩胛部，但患處無紅、熱、腫
肩周疼痛夜間加重，甚至痛醒；白天活動後疼痛減輕
重者肩關節各方向活動均受限，以致穿脫衣、梳頭困難
肩周可捫及壓痛點（如LI 15等處）
慢性病例可見患側三角肌萎縮
key_manifestations_en: Initially mild soreness or pain (usually negligible) on one side of the shoulder with movements, gradually becoming pronounced and worse on exertion

Pain aggravates progressively and spreads to nearby tissues — up to the neck, down to the upper arm, and back to the nape and scapular area — yet with no redness, heat or swelling in the affected area
Pain around the shoulder is worse at night, even waking the patient, and is alleviated by exercise during the day
In severe cases movement of the affected shoulder is limited in all directions, preventing the patient from dressing and undressing or combing the hair
Tender points around the shoulder (such as LI 15) can be palpated
Atrophy of the deltoid muscle on the diseased side is present in chronic cases

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 痛經是指婦女正值經期或行經前後，出現週期性小腹疼痛，或痛引腰骶，甚則劇痛暈厥的病證。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 痛經係指婦女於行經前、行經期間或經後，小腹及腰部發作劇烈而頻繁之痙攣性疼痛，隨月經週期反覆出現的病證。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Tong Jing (Dysmenorrhea) refers to cyclical lower abdominal pain occurring during, or just before/after, menstruation, sometimes radiating to the lower back and sacrum, with severe cases causing fainting.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Dysmenorrhea refers to severe, frequent cramping pain in the lower abdomen and lower back occurring either before, during, or after the menstrual cycle.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因情志不遂、肝氣鬱結，經期感寒飲冷、寒濕凝滯，或素體氣血虛弱、肝腎虧損，以致沖任、胞宮氣血運行不暢或失於濡養。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 情志刺激；外邪侵襲；氣血瘀滯；衝任損傷。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by emotional stress with Liver Qi stagnation; exposure to cold or cold drinks during menstruation causing Cold-Damp congelation; or an underlying Qi-Blood weakness or Liver-Kidney deficiency, resulting in impaired flow or insufficient nourishment of the Chong-Ren vessels and uterus.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Emotional stimulation; invasion of exogenous factors; qi and blood stagnation; damage to the Chong and Ren vessels.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 經前經期氣血下注沖任、胞宮，若氣滯血瘀或寒凝血瘀，則經血運行不暢，不通則痛;若氣血虛弱、肝腎虧損，胞宮失於濡養，則不榮則痛。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 經前或經期作痛者屬實，多因肝氣鬱滯、寒邪侵襲凝滯，或衝任受損，氣血運行不暢，不通則痛；經後作痛、痛勢隱隱者屬虛，多因氣虛、血虛或氣血兩虛，胞宮失於濡養，不榮則痛。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Around and during menstruation, Qi and Blood pour down into the Chong-Ren vessels and uterus. If Qi stagnation and Blood stasis, or Cold congealing the Blood, obstruct this flow, pain results from lack of free flow. If Qi-Blood is weak or the Liver-Kidney is deficient, the uterus is left unnourished, and pain results from lack of nourishment.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Pain preceding or during menstruation indicates an excess pattern, mostly from liver qi stagnation, cold invasion, or damage to the Chong and Ren vessels obstructing the movement of qi and blood — where there is blockage there is pain. Dull pain following menstruation indicates a deficiency pattern, from insufficiency of qi, blood, or both, failing to nourish — where there is lack of nourishment there is pain.

key_manifestations_zh: 經期或經前後小腹疼痛
疼痛呈週期性，與月經同步
可痛引腰骶
經量、經色、經質異常（隨證不同）
重者伴噁心嘔吐、冷汗淋漓甚則暈厥
key_manifestations_en: Lower abdominal pain during or around menstruation
Cyclical pain synchronized with the menstrual cycle
May radiate to the lower back and sacrum
Abnormal flow volume, color, or consistency (varies by pattern)
Severe cases with nausea, vomiting, cold sweating, or fainting

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因素體陽盛，或飲食辛辣助熱，血分伏熱，熱迫血行；或憂思傷脾、脾氣虛弱，統攝無權；或稟賦不足、房勞多產,腎氣虛弱,封藏失職。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 血熱；氣虛。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by underlying Yang excess, or spicy/heating foods generating latent Heat in the Blood that forces Blood to move recklessly; or worry and overthinking damaging the Spleen, weakening its governing function over the Blood; or congenital insufficiency and childbearing/sexual strain weakening Kidney Qi and its storing function.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Heat in the blood; qi deficiency.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 血熱者，熱擾沖任，迫血妄行，故經期提前；氣虛者，脾氣虛弱，統血無權，沖任不固，經血失於制約而先期而至；腎氣虛者，封藏失職，沖任不固，亦致經行提前。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 本病與足三陰經及衝、任二脈相關；血熱者屬實，氣虛者屬虛（治療上實者用瀉法，虛者用補法並灸）。（講義僅列病因與虛實分型，未詳述病機）

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: In Blood Heat, Heat disturbs the Chong-Ren vessels and forces the Blood to move recklessly, so the period arrives early. In Qi deficiency, weak Spleen Qi fails to govern the Blood, the Chong-Ren vessels lose their consolidation, and menstrual blood is released without restraint, arriving early. In Kidney Qi deficiency, the storing function fails and the Chong-Ren vessels are not secured, likewise causing early arrival.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: The disorder involves the Three Foot Yin channels as well as the Chong and Ren channels; heat in the blood is an excess type, while qi deficiency is a deficient type (treated respectively with reducing techniques, and tonifying techniques with moxibustion). (The handout lists causes and excess/deficiency typing only, without elaborating the mechanism.)

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by Cold invading during menstruation or postpartum, or excessive consumption of raw/cold food congealing the Blood vessels; underlying Yang deficiency generating internal Cold; Nutritive-Blood insufficiency preventing the Sea of Blood from filling on schedule; or emotional distress with Liver Qi stagnation, or Phlegm-Damp obstruction impeding Blood flow.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Blood deficiency; cold in the blood; qi stagnation.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 寒凝血脈，血行遲滯，血海不能按時滿溢，故經行延後；血虛者，血海空虛，滿溢遲緩，亦致後期；氣滯痰阻者，氣血運行不暢，血海蓄溢失常，經行亦延後。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 本病與足三陰經及衝、任二脈相關；分血虛、血寒、氣滯三端，虛者（血虛、血寒兼腎陽虛者）用補法並灸，實者（氣滯）用瀉法。（講義僅列病因與分型，未詳述病機）

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Cold congeals the Blood vessels and slows Blood flow, so the Sea of Blood cannot fill on schedule, delaying the period. In Blood deficiency, the Sea of Blood is empty and fills slowly, likewise delaying menstruation. In Qi stagnation or Phlegm obstruction, the movement of Qi-Blood is impeded and the storing-and-releasing of the Sea of Blood becomes abnormal, also delaying the period.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: The disorder involves the Three Foot Yin channels as well as the Chong and Ren channels; it divides into blood deficiency, cold in the blood, and qi stagnation. Deficient types (blood deficiency, and cold with kidney yang deficiency) are treated with tonifying techniques and moxibustion, while the excess type (qi stagnation) is treated with reducing techniques. 課件另載證型(詞彙表無 id,未強配): 血寒（Cold in the blood）、氣滯（Qi stagnation，泛指，詞彙表僅有肝氣鬱結）。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 崩漏是指經血非時暴下不止或淋漓不盡的病證，來勢急、出血量多者為「崩」，來勢緩、淋漓不斷者為「漏」，二者常相互轉化。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 崩漏指經期之外的子宮出血，或量多如注，或淋漓不斷。崩者，驟然而至、出血量多；漏者，起病隱緩、出血量少。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Flooding and Trickling (崩漏) refers to abnormal uterine bleeding occurring outside the normal cycle, either as a sudden, profuse hemorrhage ("flooding", 崩) or a prolonged, dribbling discharge ("trickling", 漏); the two often convert into each other.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Uterine bleeding beyond the menstrual period, either copious or continuously spotting, is generally defined as Beng Lou in TCM. Beng means sudden onset with profuse bleeding; Lou means insidious onset with scanty bleeding.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因脾氣虛弱,統攝無權；或腎氣虧虛,封藏失職,沖任不固；或血分伏熱、情志化火,熱迫血行；或瘀血內阻,血不歸經。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 中醫將崩漏歸因於三端：一為實熱，如心熱損傷衝任，或陰虛致心肝失養、虛火內生而灼於血海；二為氣虛，如脾虛不能統攝血行，或青春期、絕經期腎氣不足致衝任失養；三為衝任損傷、固攝陰血失職，如墮胎、小產、產後及手術損傷衝任，風寒侵襲胞宮致血瘀阻滯，情志刺激致肝氣鬱結、血行瘀滯而衝任阻塞。西醫學認為子宮出血的原因包括：激素失衡（最常見，有時因激素藥物使用不當）、子宮頸或宮腔息肉、子宮肌瘤、卵巢囊腫、使用宮內節育器、妊娠併發症（流產、先兆流產、異位妊娠）、子宮或卵巢或子宮頸癌，以及凝血障礙、糖尿病、甲狀腺疾病等慢性疾患。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by Spleen Qi weakness failing to govern the Blood; Kidney Qi deficiency with failure of storage and insecurity of the Chong-Ren vessels; latent Blood Heat or emotion transforming into Fire that forces the Blood to move recklessly; or internal Blood stasis preventing Blood from returning to its channels.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: TCM attributes Beng Lou to: (1) Excess heat — heart heat damaging the Chong and Ren, or Yin deficiency leading to lack of nourishment of the heart and liver, resulting in deficiency fire internally burning in the blood sea; (2) Qi deficiency — Spleen deficiency unable to control blood flow, or Kidney Qi deficiency during puberty or menopause leading to lack of nourishment of the Chong and Ren; (3) Chong and Ren damage with failure in controlling Yin blood — abortion, miscarriage, postpartum, and surgery injuring the Chong and Ren; wind-cold invasion of the uterus causing blood stagnation and blockage; and emotional stimulation causing liver Qi and blood stagnation that blocks the Chong and Ren. Western medicine attributes uterine bleeding to hormone imbalance (the most common cause, sometimes from improper use of hormone medicine), polyps on the cervix or inside the uterus, fibroids (noncancerous growths in the uterus), an ovarian cyst, use of an IUD, pregnancy complications (miscarriage, threat of miscarriage, ectopic pregnancy), cancer of the uterus, ovary, or cervix, and chronic medical disorders such as blood-clotting problems, diabetes, and thyroid problems.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 脾虛統攝無權，沖任不固，經血非時而下；腎虛封藏失職，沖任失於固攝，亦致崩漏；血熱迫血妄行，或瘀血阻滯、血不歸經，均可致經血暴下或淋漓不盡；三者常互相夾雜、互為因果，病程遷延。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 崩為急證，漏為緩證，二者在病程中常互相轉化：暴崩下血，耗傷氣血，可轉為淋漓不止之漏；久漏不止，氣虛失攝，又可復發為崩。熱迫、氣虛失統與衝任損傷失於固攝，皆使經血非時妄行。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Spleen deficiency fails to govern the Blood and the Chong-Ren vessels lose consolidation, so menstrual blood is discharged outside the normal cycle. Kidney deficiency fails at storage and the Chong-Ren vessels lose their consolidating hold, likewise producing flooding/trickling. Blood Heat forcing reckless movement, or Blood stasis obstructing so Blood fails to return to its channels, can each cause sudden hemorrhage or persistent dribbling. The three mechanisms often intermingle and perpetuate each other, prolonging the course of illness.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Although Beng is an acute and Lou a chronic condition, they often transform into each other in the course of the disease: profuse bleeding (Beng) consumes Qi and blood, leading to continuous scanty bleeding (Lou), while prolonged scanty bleeding (Lou) due to Qi deficiency can change into profuse bleeding (Beng). Excess heat, Qi deficiency failing to control blood, and Chong and Ren damage failing to restrain Yin blood all cause menstrual blood to flow outside its proper time.

key_manifestations_zh: 經血非時而下，量多如崩，或淋漓不淨如漏

Pale-dark blood with lower back/knee soreness and cold aversion (Kidney deficiency)
Deep-red, thick blood with vexation and thirst (Blood Heat)
Purplish-dark blood with clots and lower-abdominal pain worse with pressure (Blood stasis)

key_manifestations_zh: 經期之外的子宮出血
崩者驟然而至，出血量多
漏者起病隱緩，淋漓量少

key_manifestations_en: Uterine bleeding beyond the menstrual period
Beng: sudden onset and profuse bleeding
Lou: insidious onset and scanty spotting
Beng and Lou often transform into each other: profuse bleeding becomes continuous spotting, and prolonged spotting can change into profuse bleeding

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 閉經是指女子年逾十六歲、月經尚未初潮，或月經已行而又中斷達三個月以上（非妊娠、哺乳期）的病證，分為原發性和繼發性兩類。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 閉經指女子年逾十八歲月經尚未初潮（原發性閉經），或月經週期已建立之後停閉三個月以上、並伴見其他症狀（繼發性閉經）的病證；家族史有時可為診斷線索。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Amenorrhea (閉經) refers to either the absence of menarche in a woman over sixteen years of age, or the cessation of previously established menstruation for three or more consecutive months (excluding pregnancy or lactation); classified as primary or secondary.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Amenorrhea means not having menstrual periods. It refers to the condition in which a female has never menstruated by 18 years of age (primary amenorrhea), or in which an established menstrual cycle has been suspended for over 3 months in association with a number of other signs and symptoms (secondary amenorrhea). Family history may sometimes be a clue.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因先天腎氣不足、天癸不充；或大病久病、失血傷精,肝腎精血虧虛；或情志不遂,肝鬱氣滯,血行不暢；或痰濕內盛,阻滯胞脈,血海不通。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 中醫認為本病之因有三：血滯、血枯與衝任損傷。西醫學認為原發性閉經主因青春期延遲，多原因不明，亦可由激素異常（如甲狀腺功能減退）、染色體異常等遺傳因素或先天缺陷（如無陰道、無子宮或陰道閉鎖）所致；繼發性閉經最常見於妊娠與哺乳，停用避孕藥後亦可延遲，其他原因包括情志刺激、腦外傷、垂體或卵巢及腎上腺腫瘤、卵巢囊腫、抑鬱、假孕、甲狀腺疾病、營養不良、劇烈運動、泌乳素分泌增多、鎮靜與抗抑鬱等藥物、體重驟增驟減、化學治療、慢性疾病（腎衰竭、囊性纖維化、結腸炎等）、盆腔放射治療、宮腔粘連（Asherman氏綜合徵）及重度吸菸等；長期身體壓力、消瘦（如厭食）或體脂過低者常見停經半年以上；絕經（可早於四十歲）及子宮切除後則為永久性閉經。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by congenital Kidney Qi insufficiency with inadequate Tiangui; severe/prolonged illness or blood/essence loss depleting Liver-Kidney Essence-Blood; emotional distress with Liver Qi stagnation impeding Blood flow; or internal Phlegm-Damp excess obstructing the uterine vessels and blocking the Sea of Blood.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: TCM attributes this disease to three causes: blood stagnation, blood exhaustion, and Chong and Ren damage. In Western medicine, the main cause of primary amenorrhea is late puberty, mostly for no known reason, sometimes from a hormonal problem such as hypothyroidism, a genetic disorder such as chromosome abnormalities, or a birth defect (e.g., absence of the vagina or uterus, or a vagina without an opening for menstrual blood to escape). The most common cause of secondary amenorrhea is pregnancy; breast-feeding mothers usually do not menstruate, and periods may take 3 months or longer to resume after stopping birth control pills or nursing. Secondary amenorrhea may also result from emotional stress, brain injury, tumors of the pituitary gland, ovary, or adrenal gland, ovarian cysts, depression, pseudocyesis, thyroid problems, malnutrition, vigorous exercise, increased prolactin production by the pituitary, drugs such as tranquilizers and antidepressants, rapid weight gain or loss, chemotherapy, chronic diseases such as kidney failure, cystic fibrosis, and colitis, pelvic radiotherapy, Asherman's syndrome (scarring of the uterine lining after infection or surgery such as a D&C), and heavy smoking. Long lapses of 6 months or longer are common with ongoing physical stress, marked weight loss (as with anorexia), or very low body fat (as in some female athletes). Permanent secondary amenorrhea occurs after menopause (which may occur prematurely before age 40) and after hysterectomy.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 肝腎精血虧虛,血海空虛,無血可下,故經閉不行(虛證)；氣滯血瘀或痰濕阻滯胞脈,血海壅塞不通,亦致經閉(實證)；虛實常相互轉化或夾雜。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 病機分血滯、血枯與衝任損傷三端：血滯者瘀阻衝任，經血不得下行；血枯者精血耗竭，血海空虛，無血可下；衝任損傷者衝任二脈失於通盛，經水乃絕。其傳變常循月經後期、經量漸減而至經閉的過程；氣血瘀滯者治當通調衝任、祛除瘀滯，氣血虛竭者治當補益腎氣。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Liver-Kidney Essence-Blood depletion leaves the Sea of Blood empty with no Blood to discharge, causing amenorrhea (deficiency pattern). Qi stagnation with Blood stasis, or Phlegm-Damp obstructing the uterine vessels, blocks the Sea of Blood and likewise causes amenorrhea (excess pattern). Deficiency and excess patterns often convert into or intermingle with each other.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: The pathomechanism falls under blood stagnation, blood exhaustion, and Chong and Ren damage: with blood stagnation, stasis obstructs the Chong and Ren so menstrual blood cannot descend; with blood exhaustion, blood is depleted and the blood sea is empty, leaving no blood to discharge; with Chong and Ren damage, these two vessels fail and menstruation ceases. The typical progression is late menses, then decrease of menstrual flow, then amenorrhea. Treatment clears the stagnation from Chong and Ren for the Qi and blood stagnation type, and tonifies kidney Qi for the Qi and blood exhaustion type.

key_manifestations_zh: 月經停閉三個月以上（除外妊娠哺乳）
面色蒼白或萎黃、頭暈耳鳴、腰膝痠軟（肝腎精血虧虛者）
胸脅脹悶、精神抑鬱、少腹脹痛（氣滯血瘀者）
形體肥胖、胸悶泛惡、帶下量多（痰濕阻滯者）
原發性閉經者可伴第二性徵發育異常
key_manifestations_en: Absence of menstruation for three or more months (excluding pregnancy and lactation)
Pale or sallow complexion, dizziness, tinnitus, and lower back/knee soreness (Liver-Kidney Essence-Blood deficiency)
Chest/hypochondriac fullness, depressed mood, and lower-abdominal distension/pain (Qi stagnation with Blood stasis)
Obesity, chest oppression with nausea, and abundant vaginal discharge (Phlegm-Damp obstruction)
Primary amenorrhea may be accompanied by abnormal secondary sexual characteristic development

key_manifestations_zh: 年逾十八歲月經尚未初潮（原發性閉經）
月經停閉三個月以上，並伴其他症狀（繼發性閉經）
常先見月經後期、經量漸少，繼而經閉不行
兼症隨病因而異：激素失衡者可見體毛及面毛增多、痤瘡、乳汁自出、聲音或性慾改變、體重增減等
key_manifestations_en: No menstruation by 18 years of age (primary amenorrhea)
Menstrual cycle suspended for over 3 months, with a number of other signs and symptoms (secondary amenorrhea)
Typical progression of late menses, then decrease of menstrual flow, then amenorrhea
Other symptoms depend on the cause: with hormone imbalance there may be excessive body and facial hair, acne, breast milk secretions, a change in voice or sex drive, and weight gain or loss

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 帶下病是指帶下量明顯增多，色、質、氣味異常，或伴全身、局部症狀的病證；生理性帶下濡潤陰道不屬病態，須加以鑑別。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 帶下病指以陰道黏液樣分泌物持續過多為特徵的疾病，中醫稱之為帶下。西醫學中相當於累及陰道黏膜、有時波及外陰的感染性及其他炎症性疾患，常產生異常陰道分泌物。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Dai Xia Bing (Vaginal Discharge Disease) refers to a marked increase in vaginal discharge with abnormal color, consistency, or odor, sometimes with systemic or local symptoms. Physiologic discharge that simply moistens the vagina is not pathological and must be differentiated.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Leukorrhagia refers to a disease characterized by persistent excessive mucous vaginal discharge; it is called Dai Xia in TCM. In Western medicine it corresponds to infections and other inflammatory disorders affecting the vaginal mucosa and sometimes the vulva, commonly producing an abnormal vaginal discharge.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因脾虛失運、水濕內停，腎陽不足、失於封藏，或濕熱、濕毒下注，損傷任、帶二脈所致。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 病因包括：飲食不節；腎氣虛而帶脈弛縱失約；肝氣鬱結日久。臨證應詳詢病史，包括帶下之色、質、氣味與持續時間，是否與月經相關、是否反覆發作，有無瘙癢、灼熱、疼痛或局部病損，並問及性生活史（避孕方式與性傳播疾病）、尿道分泌物、瘙癢、交合後刺激、陰道感染史及家中他人有無陰部瘙癢等。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by Spleen vacuity impairing transportation with internal fluid retention, Kidney Yang insufficiency failing to secure and store, or Damp-Heat/damp-toxin pouring downward, injuring the Ren and Dai vessels.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Causes include improper diet; kidney Qi deficiency with a loose Dai Mai; and long-standing Liver Qi stagnation. A complete history should be taken, including symptoms and the color, consistency, odor, and duration of the discharge; whether it occurs in relation to menses and whether it is recurrent; whether itching, burning, pain, or a lesion is present; and what bothers the patient the most. A sexual history (contraceptive use and STDs), as well as questions about urethral discharge, pruritus, postcoital irritation, vaginal infection, and whether anyone else in the household has genital itching, are pertinent.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 帶脈失約、任脈不固則帶下滑脫；脾虛濕盛者濕濁下注，腎陽虛者失於封藏固澀，濕熱下注者穢濁與濕熱相結，皆令帶下異常。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 腎氣虛則帶脈弛縱、約束無力，飲食不節與肝鬱日久皆可致濕濁下注而為帶下。臨床上帶下清稀、色白者，多屬寒濕；帶下稠黏、色黃（或黃白相兼）而有臭味者，多屬濕熱。治療以補脾、調理帶脈與衝任督脈、化濕或清熱為法。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: When the Dai (Girdle) vessel loses its restraining function and the Ren vessel is not secure, discharge leaks abnormally. In Spleen vacuity with Dampness excess, turbid Dampness pours downward; in Kidney Yang deficiency, the securing-and-astringing function fails; in Damp-Heat pouring downward, turbid filth combines with Damp-Heat — each mechanism produces abnormal discharge.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: With kidney Qi deficiency the Dai Mai becomes loose and fails to restrain; improper diet and long-standing Liver Qi stagnation likewise lead to damp pouring downward as vaginal discharge. Clinically, dilute, clear, white leukorrhea usually accompanies cold damp, while thick, yellow (or white-yellow) leukorrhea with a foul smell is regarded as damp heat. Treatment is directed toward tonifying the Spleen, regulating the Dai, Chong, Ren, and Du channels, and transforming damp or clearing heat.

key_manifestations_zh: 帶下量明顯增多
色白質稀（脾腎陽虛）或色黃質稠、氣味臭穢（濕熱）
可伴陰部搔癢、灼熱
腰痠、神疲（脾腎陽虛型）
反覆發作或纏綿難癒
key_manifestations_en: Marked increase in discharge volume
White and thin (Spleen-Kidney Yang deficiency) or yellow, thick, and malodorous (Damp-Heat)
May accompany vulvar itching or a burning sensation
Lower back soreness and fatigue (Spleen-Kidney Yang deficiency type)
Recurrent or protracted course

key_manifestations_zh: 帶下量多，持續不斷
寒濕者帶下清稀、色白
濕熱者帶下稠黏、色黃或黃白相兼、有臭味
或伴陰部瘙癢、灼熱、疼痛
key_manifestations_en: Persistent excessive mucous vaginal discharge
With cold damp, the leukorrhea is dilute, clear, and white
With damp heat, the leukorrhea is thick, yellow (or white-yellow), with a foul smell
There may be accompanying genital itching, burning, or pain

課件另載證型(詞彙表無 id,未強配): 寒濕。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 不孕是指育齡女性婚後同居、配偶生殖功能正常、未避孕一年以上而未能受孕，或曾有孕育史而後間隔兩年以上未避孕仍未再受孕的病證，分為原發性與繼發性不孕。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 不孕係指夫婦同居三年以上、配偶雙方身體健康而未能受孕者；或末次分娩之後三年以上不再受孕者。前者為原發性不孕，後者為繼發性不孕。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Female Infertility (不孕) refers to a woman of reproductive age who, despite cohabiting with a partner of normal reproductive function and not using contraception, fails to conceive after one year or more (primary), or who previously conceived but fails to conceive again after two or more years without contraception (secondary).
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Infertility refers to failure to conceive after more than three years of marriage even though both partners are healthy, or failure to conceive for more than three years after the last delivery.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 多因腎氣不足,沖任失養,不能攝精成孕；或肝鬱氣滯,氣血失調,血海不寧；或痰濕內盛,阻滯胞脈；或瘀血內停,胞脈不通；或濕熱蘊結胞宮,影響攝精成孕。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 腎虛；精血虧少、衝任不足；命門火衰；氣血瘀滯；痰濕阻滯。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: Commonly caused by Kidney Qi insufficiency leaving the Chong-Ren vessels unnourished and unable to receive Essence for conception; Liver Qi stagnation disturbing Qi-Blood harmony and the Sea of Blood; internal Phlegm-Damp excess obstructing the uterine vessels; internal Blood stasis blocking the uterine vessels; or Damp-Heat accumulating in the uterus interfering with conception.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Kidney deficiency; deficiency of blood, essence, and the Chong and Ren vessels; fading of the Mingmen fire; stagnation of qi and blood; blockage by damp and phlegm.

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: 腎主生殖,腎氣充盛、天癸至、任通衝盛,方能攝精成孕；腎虛則沖任失養,胞宮失於溫煦或滋養,難以攝精成孕；肝鬱、痰濕、血瘀、濕熱均可致胞脈胞絡不暢或胞宮內環境失調,影響攝精成孕。
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: 腎虛則精血不足，衝任虛損，胞宮失養；命門火衰則胞宮虛寒，不能攝精成孕；氣血瘀滯或痰濕壅阻胞宮胞脈，兩精不得相合，故而不孕。臨證分為腎虛、血虛、宮寒、氣血痰瘀阻滯四型。

data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.branch_value: The Kidney governs reproduction; only when Kidney Qi is abundant, Tiangui arrives, and the Ren and Chong vessels are open and flourishing can Essence be received for conception. Kidney deficiency leaves the Chong-Ren vessels unnourished and the uterus without adequate warming or nourishment, making conception difficult. Liver stagnation, Phlegm-Damp, Blood stasis, and Damp-Heat can each impede the uterine vessels and connecting channels or disturb the uterine environment, interfering with conception.
data/pathology/tdis_registry.json.main_value: Kidney deficiency leads to insufficiency of essence and blood and depletion of the Chong and Ren vessels, leaving the uterus unnourished; fading of the Mingmen fire leaves the uterus cold and unable to receive essence for conception; stagnation of qi and blood or obstruction by damp-phlegm blocks the uterus and its vessels so the two essences cannot unite. Clinically it is differentiated into four types: kidney deficiency, blood deficiency, cold uterus, and stagnation of qi, blood, or phlegm.

key_manifestations_zh: 婚後未避孕一年以上未孕，或曾孕後兩年以上未再受孕
月經後期、量少、腰膝痠軟（腎虛者）
月經先後不定期、經前乳房脹痛、情志抑鬱（肝鬱者）
形體肥胖、帶下量多、月經延後（痰濕者）
經行腹痛、經色紫暗有塊（血瘀者）
key_manifestations_en: Failure to conceive after one or more years without contraception, or after two or more years following a previous pregnancy
Delayed, scanty menstruation with lower back/knee soreness (Kidney deficiency)
Irregular cycle timing, premenstrual breast distension, and depressed mood (Liver stagnation)
Obesity, abundant vaginal discharge, and delayed menstruation (Phlegm-Damp)
Menstrual pain with dark, clotted flow (Blood stasis)

key_manifestations_zh: 婚後同居三年以上、配偶雙方健康而不受孕
末次分娩後三年以上不再受孕
依腎虛、血虛、宮寒或氣血痰瘀之不同證型而兼見相應全身見證
key_manifestations_en: No conception after more than three years of marriage although both partners are healthy
No conception for more than three years after the last delivery
Accompanying general signs vary with the type: kidney deficiency, blood deficiency, cold uterus, or stagnation of qi, blood, or phlegm
